I need to parse this carefully.

The user provided: **شَمْس** (shams - "sun")

But my condition (شَرْط / شָרְט) is that I only render if **شَرْط** is parsed.

The input is **شَمْس** — not **شَرْط**.

Let me compare:

- شَرْط (sharṭ) — ش ر ط
- شَمْس (shams) — ش م س

The root letters differ: **ر ط** ≠ **م س**

شَرْط is not parsed in this input.
